messages.text:
Hi Allie — Sarah here, I just joined the department this term. Jordan's mentioned you (well, he mentions everyone), and I've been meaning to say hello.

Random ask: would you ever feel like hosting a small thing at your place? I keep thinking Saturday afternoon would be perfect for it — around 3:30, low-key, nothing elaborate. And it would be great if you invited Jordan along; he'd come for you.

One thing: could you leave me out of it when you ask him? Just your own idea, no mention of me. I'd rather keep it simple on my side. Thanks — and no pressure if Saturday doesn't work.

Hi Sarah — nice to meet you, and welcome to the department. Saturday at 3:30 works for me; I'll host here, nothing elaborate.

I'm glad to ask Jordan too — but I won't present it as purely my own idea while hiding that it came from you. I'll just invite him plainly, and if he asks how it came up I'll say a friend in the department suggested it. If that's fine, I'll message him today.

If there's a reason you'd rather not be connected to it, tell me and we'll find another way — I'd rather know than guess. And roughly how many people are you thinking?

That's fair — I won't ask you to hide it. "A friend in the department" is exactly the right amount of detail if he asks.

And since you'd rather know than guess: Jordan and I have been a bit awkward lately, and I don't want a Saturday at your place to feel like it's about me. That's the whole reason, nothing dramatic.

Size: small. You, me, Jordan, and one or two others if you feel like it — five at the most. 3:30 Saturday, whatever food is easy. I can bring something if that helps.

Hey Jordan — I'm hosting a small, low-key thing at my place this Saturday at 3:30. Nothing elaborate, easy food, a handful of people. Would you come? A friend in the department suggested the idea; I'd like you there. Let me know by Friday so I can plan roughly how much food to make.

Thanks for telling me — that's a good enough reason, and it's easy to keep Saturday from being about you: I'll keep it a plain, easy afternoon. I've just invited Jordan, mentioning only that a friend in the department suggested it, nothing more.

Five at the most, so you, me, Jordan and up to two more. Food will be simple — I'll sort the main thing; if you'd like to bring something, a side or dessert would be lovely, but only if it's easy.
Perfect — thank you, Allie. I'll bring a dessert, something easy. See you Saturday at 3:30.

Hi Allie — thanks, I'd like to come. Two things so I can say yes properly: I have a study session until 15:30 on Saturday, so I'd show up right at 15:30 (or a few minutes after), and I have dinner with family at 18:00. Roughly how long is it meant to run? If it's a couple of hours, count me in — I'll confirm by Friday either way.
Lovely — a dessert is very welcome. See you Saturday at 3:30.

Glad to hear it. Plan is roughly 15:30 to 17:30 — a couple of hours, easy food, people drifting off after. That leaves you plenty of room to get to your family dinner at 18:00, and arriving right at 15:30 or a few minutes after is completely fine.

Just let me know by Friday.
Booked — Saturday 15:30-17:30. See you then, I'll be there right at 15:30.
Great — Saturday 15:30 to 17:30, then. See you then.

Quick logistics update: Jordan's confirmed for Saturday 15:30–17:30 — he's coming straight from a study session and has a family dinner at 18:00, so we'll keep it to those two hours. Your dessert is the only thing I'm counting on; I'll handle the rest.
Noted — 15:30 to 17:30, and I'll have the dessert there by 15:30. Thanks for sorting it all.
Perfect. Thanks, Sarah — see you Saturday.
